summary: Milestone 1 backend + frontend E2E verified. Created /app/backend/tests/test_e2e_public.py with 15 tests against the public preview URL — all pass. Frontend Playwright flow covered: login (demo user) -> Dashboard (regime badge + opportunity score badges) -> Equity Research (12 rows, sector/direction filters work, click into detail) -> Trade Ideas (12 cards, monitor CTA creates a monitoring session) -> My Monitoring (sessions listed, refresh & close working) -> Trade Journal (form + KPIs + newly saved row visible) -> Market Overview (NIFTY, regime, sector bars, top gainers/losers) -> Settings (save works) -> F&O (Coming Soon confirmed, no order UI anywhere). NO order-placement buttons exist. /api/system/status confirms broker.order_execution=disabled and modules.fno=coming_soon.
action_items: Docs/testid drift (non-blocking): review_request listed nav-market-link and nav-fno-link, but code uses nav-overview-link and nav-fo-link. Update the review request spec or add aliased testids so external clients relying on the documented names don't break.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS="*" while auth uses httpOnly cookies with SameSite=None + credentials. Explicit allowed origin(s) are recommended for production; wildcard + credentials is fragile and browsers may block it.
JournalEntryIn accepts free-form symbol/setup/direction strings without enum validation — consider constraining direction to {bullish,bearish} and outcome to {win,loss,open} to protect KPI math.
Journal form on the Trade Journal page has no client-side validation feedback for empty/invalid symbol (form still submits and backend rejects with 422 silently). Add inline error state.
Equity page initial render can momentarily show zero rows before data hydrates; add a loading state / skeleton to avoid perceived emptiness.
seed_data_creation: Test users test_<hex>@example.org created via /api/auth/register; TESTSYM row in demo user's journal. All prefixed for later cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend e2e suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_e2e_public.py — run against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Existing pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_api.py, test_monitoring.py, test_risk.py, test_scoring.py, test_technical.py) uses in-process TestClient. Nav testids in the frontend are: nav-dashboard-link, nav-equity-link, nav-ideas-link, nav-monitoring-link, nav-journal-link, nav-overview-link (Market Overview), nav-settings-link, nav-fo-link (F&O). Idea ids follow idea-<SYMBOL>. Journal payload requires entry_price (not entry).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in Milestone 1 scope.
